summary:
SPACE TIME CAPSULE is an educational website that explores the stories of human-made objects left across our solar system. It introduces learners to important space missions, including Apollo 11, Perseverance, Ingenuity, and Voyager 1.

The website presents mission information, purposes, discoveries, images, and their lasting legacy in a simple and engaging way. It helps students understand how humanity has explored space and what traces of these missions remain today.

Our goal is to make space exploration history easier to discover and understand through an interactive learning experience.
details:
SPACE TIME CAPSULE is an interactive educational website designed to help students explore humanity's footprints in space. It presents the stories of four important missions: Apollo 11, Perseverance, Ingenuity, and Voyager 1.

Users can explore mission cards, view images, learn about each mission's purpose and discoveries, and understand the lasting legacy of human-made objects in space. The website also includes a timeline and a quiz to make learning more engaging.

We developed the website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. HTML structures the content, CSS creates the layout and visual design, and JavaScript supports interactive features. The website is hosted using GitHub Pages. We used publicly available NASA mission information and imagery to support the educational content.

The creative idea behind this project is to present space exploration as a time capsule: each mission preserves a story of human curiosity, discovery, and innovation. By bringing these stories together in one accessible website, we aim to make space science easier and more interesting for students and young learners.
